login.captcha.label: Security verification
v17Recovery.forgotDescription: Enter your username or email. A superuser will review your request before a secure reset link is sent to the relevant account.
v17Recovery.forgotSuccess: If the account exists, your password reset request has been submitted for superuser review. A reset email will only be sent after approval.
v17Recovery.forgotNote: For security, the same status is shown whether or not the account exists.
v17Recovery.resetDescription: Use the secure link sent to your email to set a new password and regain access to SQR.
v17Recovery.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
v17Recovery.resetSuccess: Your password has been reset. You can now sign in with your username and new password.
v17Recovery.activationDescription: Complete your first-time account setup using the activation link sent to your email. This step is required before you can use SQR.
v17Recovery.activationInvalid: This activation link is invalid or has expired.
v17Recovery.activationSuccess: Your password has been created. You will be taken to the sign-in page shortly.
v17.intro: Secure access to your SQR workspace.
v17.offline: You appear to be offline. Your input remains in this form; try again when your connection returns.
v17.subtitle: Sign in to continue to your SQR workspace.
v17.assurance: Account permissions and additional verification remain enforced according to system configuration.
v17.support: Don’t have access? Contact the system administrator.
v17.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to complete sign-in.
v17.mfaHelp: Enter or paste all six digits. If the code has just changed, use the latest code.
v17.mfaSupport: Can’t access your authenticator app? Contact the system administrator.
v17.lockedMessage: Sign-in is locked. Wait before trying again or contact your administrator.
v17.contactAdmin: Contact your administrator to restore account access.
v17.captchaHelp: The server requires an additional security check before your next sign-in attempt.
